name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      cdk_version:
        description: "The CDK version to upgrade to (e.g., 7.6.5)"
        required: true
        default: "7.6.5"
      connector_name:
        description: "The name of the connector to upgrade (e.g., source-gitlab)"
        required: true
        default: "source-gitlab"

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
          cache: "pip"

      - name: Install airbyte-ci
        run: |
          pip install airbyte-ci

      - name: Upgrade CDK version for connector
        run: |
          # Update metadata.yaml
          sed -i "s/baseImage: source-declarative-manifest:7.6.1/baseImage: source-declarative-manifest:${{ inputs.cdk_version }}/g" "airbyte-integrations/connectors/${{ inputs.connector_name }}/metadata.yaml"
          
          # Bump connector version
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(grep -A 1 "version:" "airbyte-integrations/connectors/${{ inputs.connector_name }}/metadata.yaml" | grep -v "version:" | tr -d " ")
          NEW_VERSION=$(echo $CURRENT_VERSION | awk -F. '{print $1"."$2"."($3+1)}')
          sed -i "s/version: $CURRENT_VERSION/version: $NEW_VERSION/g" "airbyte-integrations/connectors/${{ inputs.connector_name }}/metadata.yaml"
          
          # Add changelog entry
          echo "- Updated CDK version from 7.6.1 to ${{ inputs.cdk_version }}" >> "docs/integrations/sources/${{ inputs.connector_name }}.md"

      - name: Validate connector metadata
        run: |
          airbyte-ci connectors validate --connector-path "airbyte-integrations/connectors/${{ inputs.connector_name }}"

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore(${{ inputs.connector_name }}): Update CDK version to ${{ inputs.cdk_version }}"

      - name: Push changes
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/update-cdk-${{ inputs.cdk_version }}
